title: habenaria marginata var. flavescens
intro: Habenaria marginata var. flavescens, commonly known as the yellow-flowered yellow beard orchid, is a flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae) native to tropical regions. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and research has identified several health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Habenaria marginata var. flavescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
